import sys, json, random, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/site'); sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/ref'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import reference, gen
from pipeline import execute
rng = random.Random(99)
stats = collections.Counter()
for t in range(1500):
    req = gen.gen_request(rng)
    out = execute(req)
    stats['cases'] += 1
    for c in out['catalog']:
        stats['clusters'] += len(c['clusters'])
        stats['kept'] += len(c['priority'])
        stats['noise'] += len(c['noise'])
        stats['fragments'] += len(c['fragments'])
        stats['entries>0'] += 1 if c['entries'] else 0
        stats['entries_clipped'] += 1 if (c['entries'] == req['capacity']['exact']+1 and c['entries']>0) else 0
        stats['backup>1'] += 1 if len(c['backup'])>1 else 0
    for i in out['installs']:
        stats['install_'+i['status']] += 1
        stats['resident%d' % len(i['resident'])] += 1
    for d in out['decisions']:
        stats['reason_'+d['reason']] += 1
        stats['epoch%d' % min(d['epoch'],3)] += 1
    stats['final_res%d' % len(out['final']['resident'])] += 1
    stats['used_range%d' % min(out['final']['used']['range'],3)] += 1
print(dict(stats))
PYEOF
